name: Jeongwook Oh
biography: started his career as a firewall developer back in mid 90s. After that he spent few years doing security audits and penetration testing. Finally, he moved to California and joined eEye crew and did some IPS stuff. It involved userland and kernel land hacking stuff. Now he's working for WebSense Inc where he's doing research related to malware and exploit detection.
